description: Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Department.
reasoning: This gazette content announces the implementation of the Sri Lanka Coastal Zone and Coastal Resource Management Plan 2024-2029, which was prepared under the Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Act, No. 57 of 1981. The content focuses on regulatory frameworks, environmental management plans, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it establishes a formal management plan under existing legislation.
